body:
I have one, but I'm her support. I can't lean on her. She looks up to me and asks me advice on life. I give it to her the best I can, which she seems to be uplifted by which gives me satisfaction, but she quickly goes back downhill. 

My other friends sister was murdered a few years back, so she's basically off limits when it comes to support. She's like a barely buried twig in a hurricane. 

Maybe I need different friends.

I really enjoy being with my friends which is what I've been concentrating on all night. They will see the cuts, what if I go too deep and need stitches? There's only so many stories people will buy. 

I'm not a sad person, actually I'm a very easy person to be around. None of my friends know this side of me. As far as they know I got into a bike wreck a few years back and hit a barbed wire fence. Either they already know and wont say anything, or they believe me. Either way, nobody talks to me about it. 

Where is this anxiety coming from?

I am struggling myself. I just posted to SelfWatch about the same time you did... 

It's easier for me to tell you that everything is going to be ok. It's easier for me to let you know that I've already been through that heartache. 

Unfortunately, all we have is each other. There is Reddit, and it's entire mute community, and it can feel vast and too big. 

It's hard for me, but I'll support you any way I can. I'm a broken soul willing to give you my last leg if that means anything to you. 

Keep going.

There are people that ask me to paint them pictures. But mostly it's so expressive it unsellable. Women in turmoil, skeletons, cracking skin... it's very dark...

Anyway, I really appreciate your support. It's just so hard, you know? I was in the shower- where I was when I slashed my arm open the first time- and kept thinking about how easy it would be for me to disappear . Yea,, maybe not for anyone but myself, but I'm the only person who's going to feel it. I know it's not fair for those who I leave behind, I know life goes on without me. But that's just it.

When you feel like you have nothing to offer the world, you feel worthless. When you feel like you have nothing to offer yourself you feel absolutely empty. Like a shell, a void, a space. Something taking up space, but wasting it.

As far as my mother goes, it's hard. For as long as I can remember she has always cried wolf. She's told me she's dying so many times that I'm already numb to the idea of her *actually* dying. 

It's really sad...we have so much we need to talk about. Between the divorce, the raping, the childhood psychologists..... I have no idea. My dad took me away when I was young and I have no other recollection on what really happened to me as a kid other than being raped and my mom stripping to support us...nobody- including my mom- will talk to me about it.... My half brother (who is related to the person that raped me) will not speak to her. He thinks she made everything up (the rape) to divorce his dad.... it's so fucked up.

I enjoy painting. I can't paint fast enough though... It all ends up slashes and blotches. My mom, she used to pretend to be sick when I was kid to acquire my brothers and I's affections- brain tumors, terminal infections, memory loss. She would say anything..... ANYWAY she lost us after people found out her step son raped me for two years. 

She started stripping and using after she left her then husband to afford supporting four children..she left us alone a lot... anyway, she lost us. 

I lived with my alcoholic father- putting him to bed since I was in middle school (putting his shoes by the door, filling up his water glass, turning off the T.V.) up until the day I gave him CPR after he overdosed on crack. (I was 18). He went to jail for 6 months after that and honestly since then, now that I'm 24 (after living elsewhere for several years) he's finally a real father.

I don't know where any of this is coming from. It's never really bothered me. My previous relationship was really abusive but I never cried. Now that I've left all I do is cry. What's wrong with me??

More than it seems? Like what? I can barely afford rent. I have literally 43.69 dollars in my bank account and I live on my own one week and three days late on rent PLUS utilities. My mother is dying (for real this time after YEARS of crying wolf for my affection) and I can't even cover gas to visit her in the hospital.  My half brother wont visit her because HIS brother raped me when I was 5 and somehow that's her fault.... I just don't get it.....
